description: Booki MVP - Native iOS app for independent sports bookies to manage their book, players, and bets. Built with Swift and SwiftUI, using SwiftData for local persistence with architecture designed to support cloud backend migration later.

userStories.title: Initialize iOS project structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the base Xcode project with proper architecture.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Xcode project with SwiftUI App lifecycle
Set up folder structure: Models, Views, ViewModels, Services
Configure SwiftData ModelContainer in App entry point
Add .gitignore for Xcode/Swift projects
Project builds successfully

userStories.title: Create Bookie model with SwiftData
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store bookie accounts locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Bookie @Model class with id (UUID), email, name, createdAt, updatedAt
Add subscriptionStatus enum: active, inactive, trial
Model integrates with SwiftData ModelContainer
Project builds successfully

userStories.title: Create Player model with SwiftData
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store player seats that belong to bookies.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Player @Model class with id, name, email (optional), creditLimit, status
Add playerStatus enum: active, archived, banned
Add relationship to Bookie (many players to one bookie)
Project builds successfully

userStories.title: Create Bet model with lifecycle states
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store bets with their full lifecycle state machine.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Bet @Model class with id, eventId, market, side, odds (Int for American odds), stake (Decimal), status, createdAt
Add betStatus enum: pending, accepted, declined, readyToGrade, graded, settled, void
Add gradeResult enum: win, loss, push (optional field)
Add relationship to Player
Project builds successfully

userStories.title: Create LedgerEntry model for append-only financial records
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an append-only ledger for tracking all balance changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Create LedgerEntry @Model class with id, amount (Decimal), type, description, createdAt
Add entryType enum: settlement, adjustment, paymentLogged, reversal
Add relationship to Player (required) and Bet (optional)
No update methods - append-only by design
Project builds successfully

userStories.title: Create Event and Market models for odds data
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store sports events and their betting markets.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Event @Model class with id, sport, league, homeTeam, awayTeam, startTime, status, finalScore (optional)
Add eventStatus enum: scheduled, live, final
Create Market @Model class with id, type, sideA, sideB, oddsA (Int), oddsB (Int), updatedAt
Add marketType enum: spread, total, moneyline
Add relationship: Market belongs to Event
Project builds successfully

userStories.title: Implement LiabilityService for odds calculations
userStories.description: As a bookie, I need accurate liability calculations based on American odds.
acceptanceCriteria: Create LiabilityService with static calculation methods
Negative odds payout: stake * (100 / abs(odds))
Positive odds payout: stake * (odds / 100)
Function handles both accepted and pending bets
Add unit tests for liability calculations
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement ExposureService for risk calculations
userStories.description: As a bookie, I need to see my exposure per event grouped by side.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ExposureService that queries bets by event
Calculate exposure by grouping bets by event and side
Include pending (soft exposure) and accepted (hard exposure) bets
Exclude declined, void, graded, and settled bets
Event exposure = max(total liability per side)
Add unit tests for exposure calculations
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement BalanceService derived from ledger
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to derive player balances from the append-only ledger.
acceptanceCriteria: Create BalanceService that calculates balance from ledger entries
Calculate available credit: creditLimit - openLiability - balanceOwed
No stored balance field - always derived from ledger
Add unit tests for balance calculations
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement BetService for bet operations
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service layer for all bet-related operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Create BetService with submitBet method (creates pending bet, snapshots odds)
Add acceptBet method (pending -> accepted)
Add declineBet method (pending -> declined)
Add voidBet method (accepted -> void)
Validate stake against available credit
Project builds successfully

userStories.title: Implement GradingService for bet outcomes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service for grading and settling bets.
acceptanceCriteria: Create GradingService with gradeBet method (accepted -> graded, sets gradeResult)
Add settleBet method that creates ledger entries based on outcome
Win: positive ledger entry for payout amount
Loss: negative ledger entry for stake amount
Push: zero-sum ledger entry (stake returned)
Project builds successfully

userStories.title: Implement PlayerService for player management
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service for player CRUD and status changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Create PlayerService with addPlayer method
Add archivePlayer method (sets status to archived)
Add banPlayer method (sets status to banned)
Add adjustBalance method (creates adjustment ledger entry)
Archived players retain history but excluded from active counts
Banned players cannot submit bets
Project builds successfully
